media_assets_error_code_check.name: media_assets_error_code_check
media_assets_error_code_check.value: ("media_assets"."status" = 'failed') = ("media_assets"."error_code" is not null) and ("media_assets"."error_code" is null or "media_assets"."error_code" in ('IMAGE_REJECTED', 'IMAGE_FAILED'))

media_assets_ready_file_check.name: media_assets_ready_file_check
media_assets_ready_file_check.value: "media_assets"."status" <> 'ready' or ("media_assets"."public_id" is not null and "media_assets"."url" is not null and "media_assets"."width" is not null and "media_assets"."height" is not null and "media_assets"."bytes" is not null and "media_assets"."format" is not null)

post_targets_error_code_check.name: post_targets_error_code_check
post_targets_error_code_check.value: ("post_targets"."status" <> 'failed' or "post_targets"."error_code" is not null) and ("post_targets"."error_code" is null or "post_targets"."status" in ('failed', 'pending_approval'))
